pairs.target: shěn yàn zhōu jiāng tú zhé hǎo , dì huán xǔ cén , jiě xià bèináng wài de diàosuǒ .
pairs.english: Shen Yanzhou folded the map, returned it to Xu Cen and unfastened the hauling line on the outside of his pack.
pairs.hanzi: 沈砚舟将图折好，递还许岑，解下背囊外的吊索。

pairs.target: dùhéng yě bǎ nà fù xiè le .
pairs.english: Du Heng removed his set too.
pairs.hanzi: 杜衡也把那副卸了。

pairs.target: liǎngquān shéng fàngdào zhuàntái nèicè lián qiáng de shí dūn páng ,
pairs.english: The two coils of rope were set beside the stone pier joined to the wall on the inner side of the landing.
pairs.hanzi: 两圈绳放到转台内侧连墙的石墩旁，

pairs.target: shào píng cóng bèi jià páng chōuchū mù huálún , mǔzhǐ bō zhe lún cáo zhuǎn le bànquān , jiāng tiěgōu yìzhī zhī bǎikāi .
pairs.english: Shao Ping pulled a wooden pulley from beside the pack frame, flicked its grooved rim with his thumb to spin it half a turn, and laid out the iron hooks one by one.
pairs.hanzi: 邵平从背架旁抽出木滑轮，拇指拨着轮槽转了半圈，将铁钩一只只摆开。

pairs.target: lín zhào jiē zhù gǔn dào jiǎo biān de shéngkòu , fàng huí tā shǒubiān .
pairs.english: Lin Zhao caught a rope buckle rolling to her feet and put it back by his hand.
pairs.hanzi: 林照接住滚到脚边的绳扣，放回他手边。

pairs.target: " xiān bú jià ? "
pairs.english: “Not rigging it yet?”
pairs.hanzi: “先不架？”

pairs.target: tā wèn .
pairs.english: she asked.
pairs.hanzi: 她问。

pairs.target: " děng jiào . "
pairs.english: “Wait till we're called.”
pairs.hanzi: “等叫。”

pairs.target: shào píng cháo xiàmiàn piān le piān liǎn , " bié dǎng tuìlù . "
pairs.english: Shao Ping inclined his head toward the court below. “Don't block the retreat.”
pairs.hanzi: 邵平朝下面偏了偏脸，“别挡退路。”

pairs.target: tā bǎ jiǎo wǎng nèi shōu .
pairs.english: She drew her feet farther in.
pairs.hanzi: 她把脚往内收。

pairs.target: wēn shù zuìhòu shànglái yítàng , jiāng bèináng lián yóudēng liúzài yàobāo páng , qǔ le duǎndāo , biàn yòu xiàqù .
pairs.english: Wen Shu came up one last time, left his pack and oil lamp beside the medical bag, took a short knife and went down again.
pairs.hanzi: 温述最后上来一趟，将背囊连油灯留在药包旁，取了短刀，便又下去。

pairs.target: xǔ cén shōu hǎo mùxiá , yánzhe tàn guò de shíjiē zǒu zài tā hòumiàn .
pairs.english: Xu Cen secured the wooden case and followed him along the tested steps.
pairs.hanzi: 许岑收好木匣，沿着探过的石阶走在他后面。

pairs.target: dùhéng tà dào nà pái lùchū shuǐmiàn de shí biānshàng , jiǎojiān zuǒyòu niǎnguò , cái jiāng dùn jǔqǐ .
pairs.english: Du Heng stepped onto the row of stone edges showing above the water, working his toes from side to side before raising his shield.
pairs.hanzi: 杜衡踏到那排露出水面的石边上，脚尖左右碾过，才将盾举起。

pairs.target: shěn yàn zhōu zài tā zuǒcè tíngzhù , jiànjiān chuí zài shuǐshàng .
pairs.english: Shen Yanzhou stopped on his left, his sword tip hanging above the water.
pairs.hanzi: 沈砚舟在他左侧停住，剑尖垂在水上。

pairs.target: qī lán kào hòu yíkuài gāo shí zhàn zhe , lí tāmen jǐbù yuǎn , gōngxián lākāi le .
pairs.english: Qi Lan stood farther back on a high stone, a few paces from them, her bow drawn.
pairs.hanzi: 戚岚靠后一块高石站着，离他们几步远，弓弦拉开了。

pairs.target: jiàn méiyǒu cháo dà de qù .
pairs.english: The arrow didn't go toward the big one.
pairs.hanzi: 箭没有朝大的去。

pairs.target: tā cā guò duàn zhù , dīngjìn gǒng xià yídào zhǎi yǐng .
pairs.english: It skimmed past the broken pillar and buried itself in a narrow shape beneath the arch.
pairs.hanzi: 它擦过断柱，钉进拱下一道窄影。

pairs.target: shuǐhuā měngdì zhàqǐ , nà dōngxī niǔguò shēn , dài zhe jiàn tuō chū bànjié huībái de bèi , jǐtiáo xì tuǐ pāi dé shuǐmiàn luàn xiǎng .
pairs.english: Water suddenly burst up; the creature twisted, dragging half its gray-white back clear with the arrow in it, several thin legs thrashing noisily on the surface.
pairs.hanzi: 水花猛地炸起，那东西扭过身，带着箭拖出半截灰白的背，几条细腿拍得水面乱响。

pairs.target: lìngyìzhī què cóng zhù hòu cuān le chūlái .
pairs.english: But the other one darted out from behind the pillar.
pairs.hanzi: 另一只却从柱后蹿了出来。

pairs.target: " yòubiān . "
pairs.english: “Right,”
pairs.hanzi: “右边。”

pairs.target: xǔ cén shuō .
pairs.english: Xu Cen said.
pairs.hanzi: 许岑说。

pairs.target: qī lán yǐjīng huàn le fāngxiàng .
pairs.english: Qi Lan had already changed direction.
pairs.hanzi: 戚岚已经换了方向。

pairs.target: dìèrzhī jiàn gāng líxián , lín zhào ěrbiān hūrán xiǎngqǐ jí jiān de yìshēng , xiàng yǒurén zài jìnchù bēng duàn le sīxiàn .
pairs.english: Just as the second arrow left the string, Lin Zhao suddenly heard a sound so piercing, as though someone nearby had snapped a taut silk thread beside her ear.
pairs.hanzi: 第二支箭刚离弦，林照耳边忽然响起极尖的一声，像有人在近处绷断了丝线。

pairs.target: nà zhī xiǎoshòu bèi xiān xiàngcèmiàn , zhuàng shàng zhù gēn , fān zài shuǐ lǐ .
pairs.english: The small beast was flung sideways, struck the pillar's base and overturned in the water.
pairs.hanzi: 那只小兽被掀向侧面，撞上柱根，翻在水里。

pairs.target: tā zhèng le liǎngxià , méi zài qǐlái .
pairs.english: It struggled twice, then didn't rise again.
pairs.hanzi: 它挣了两下，没再起来。

pairs.target: hái chā zhe jiàn de nà zhī tuì jìn le téng yǐng .
pairs.english: The one still carrying the arrow retreated into the vine shadows.
pairs.hanzi: 还插着箭的那只退进了藤影。

pairs.target: duàn gǒng dǐxià de yìngké huǎnhuǎn táigāo .
pairs.english: The hard shell beneath the broken arch rose slowly.
pairs.hanzi: 断拱底下的硬壳缓缓抬高。

pairs.target: shěn yàn zhōu wǎngqiánzǒu le liǎngbù , jiànjiān zài shuǐ lǐ huà le yídào .
pairs.english: Shen Yanzhou took two paces forward, drawing a line in the water with his sword tip.
pairs.hanzi: 沈砚舟往前走了两步，剑尖在水里划了一道。

pairs.target: nà liǎngtiáo xì xū cháo tā zhuǎnguò lái , fú dī de shēnzi zhòurán yì suō , jǐtiáo tuǐ tóngshí chēngkāi , shuǐmiàn biàn cháo liǎngbiān fēn le chūqù .
pairs.english: The two slender feelers turned toward him; its body, held low, suddenly contracted, its legs braced all at once, and the water parted to either side.
pairs.hanzi: 那两条细须朝他转过来，伏低的身子骤然一缩，几条腿同时撑开，水面便朝两边分了出去。

pairs.target: lín zhào méixiǎngdào tā néng zhèyàng kuài .
pairs.english: Lin Zhao hadn't thought it could move so fast.
pairs.hanzi: 林照没想到它能这样快。

pairs.target: dùn shàng xiǎngqǐ yìshēng mēn zhuàng .
pairs.english: A dull thud sounded against the shield.
pairs.hanzi: 盾上响起一声闷撞。

pairs.target: dùhéng de zuǒ jiān wǎnghòu yì chén , jiǎo què méi tuì , jiǎoxià jǐlǚ hēiní cóng shífèng lǐ mào le chūlái .
pairs.english: Du Heng's left shoulder sank back, but his feet held; wisps of black mud welled from the stone cracks beneath them.
pairs.hanzi: 杜衡的左肩往后一沉，脚却没退，脚下几缕黑泥从石缝里冒了出来。

pairs.target: nà dōngxī dǐng zhe dùn , bèi ké shàng de shuǐ hái méi tǎng jìn , qián tuǐ yǐ cóng dùn yán ràoguò , liándāo shìde wǎng dùhéng xītóu guāqù .
pairs.english: The creature pressed against the shield; before the water had finished draining from its back shell, a foreleg curled around the rim and swept like a sickle toward Du Heng's knee.
pairs.hanzi: 那东西顶着盾，背壳上的水还没淌尽，前腿已从盾沿绕过，镰刀似的往杜衡膝头刮去。

pairs.target: shěn yàn zhōu de jiàn luò le xiàlái .
pairs.english: Shen Yanzhou's sword came down.
pairs.hanzi: 沈砚舟的剑落了下来。

pairs.target: lín zhàomíng míng kànjiàn jiànfēng bèi yìngké dǎng zài wàimiàn , xià yíshùn , rèn shàng què guà le hēihóng de shuǐ .
pairs.english: Lin Zhao distinctly saw the blade held outside by the shell, yet in the next instant black-red fluid hung from its edge.
pairs.hanzi: 林照明明看见剑锋被硬壳挡在外面，下一瞬，刃上却挂了黑红的水。

pairs.target: nàtiáo qián tuǐ xié zhéxiàqù , duànkǒu zhī shèng yìcéng jīn lián zhe .
pairs.english: The foreleg buckled sideways; only a band of sinew joined the cut ends.
pairs.hanzi: 那条前腿斜折下去，断口只剩一层筋连着。

pairs.target: tā hái méi xiǎng míngbái jiàn shì zěnme jìnqù de , dùhéng yǐ dǐng zhe dùn , xiàngqián nuó le bànbù .
pairs.english: Before she could understand how the sword had got inside, Du Heng had already edged half a step forward behind his shield.
pairs.hanzi: 她还没想明白剑是怎么进去的，杜衡已顶着盾，向前挪了半步。

pairs.target: " lǎo wēn . "
pairs.english: “Wen.”
pairs.hanzi: “老温。”

pairs.target: wēn shù zhàn zài tā hòumiàn , yìng le yìshēng .
pairs.english: Wen Shu stood behind him and answered.
pairs.hanzi: 温述站在他后面，应了一声。

pairs.target: tānkāi de yòushǒu wēiwēi shōulǒng , shǒu bèishàng jǐtiáo xì jīn mànmàn gǔqǐ .
pairs.english: His open right hand closed slightly, and a few fine tendons slowly stood out on its back.
pairs.hanzi: 摊开的右手微微收拢，手背上几条细筋慢慢鼓起。

pairs.target: dùhéng de hūxī hūrán wěn le .
pairs.english: Du Heng's breathing suddenly steadied.
pairs.hanzi: 杜衡的呼吸忽然稳了。

pairs.target: nà dōngxī yòu wǎngqián yā , dùn yán fāchū yízhèn mùtou jiǎo jǐn shìde xiǎngshēng .
pairs.english: The creature pressed forward again; the shield rim let out a creak like wood being twisted tight.
pairs.hanzi: 那东西又往前压，盾沿发出一阵木头绞紧似的响声。

pairs.target: tā yuánběn chénxiàqù de jiān què tái le qǐlái , wò dùn de shǒuzhǐ yìgēn gēn kòujǐn , jìng jiāng nà kē dī fú de tóudǐng piān le yìdiǎn .
pairs.english: His previously lowered shoulder rose instead; his fingers clenched one by one around the shield, and he even nudged aside the low head a little.
pairs.hanzi: 他原本沉下去的肩却抬了起来，握盾的手指一根根扣紧，竟将那颗低伏的头顶偏了一点。

pairs.target: " zàiyǒu yíxià . "
pairs.english: “One more,”
pairs.hanzi: “再有一下。”

pairs.target: wēn shùshuō .
pairs.english: Wen Shu said.
pairs.hanzi: 温述说。

pairs.target: dùhéng duǎncù dì tǔ le kǒuqì , kuà chū yòujiǎo .
pairs.english: Du Heng exhaled sharply and stepped out with his right foot.
pairs.hanzi: 杜衡短促地吐了口气，跨出右脚。

pairs.target: zhèhuí lín zhàokàn qīng le .
pairs.english: This time Lin Zhao saw clearly.
pairs.hanzi: 这回林照看清了。

pairs.target: tā búshì bǎ dùn wǎngqián tuī , érshì lián jiāndài yāo , yìqǐ zhuàng le shàngqù .
pairs.english: He wasn't pushing the shield forward; instead he drove into it with his shoulder and waist together.
pairs.hanzi: 他不是把盾往前推，而是连肩带腰，一起撞了上去。

pairs.target: shuǐ cóng tā xiǎotuǐ liǎngpáng xiàng hòu pēn kāi , céngcéng yìngké cháo zuǒ yì wāi , lùchū le dǐxià yìtiáo ruǎn bái de fèng .
pairs.english: Water sprayed back on both sides of his calves; the layered shell tilted left, exposing a soft white seam beneath.
pairs.hanzi: 水从他小腿两旁向后喷开，层层硬壳朝左一歪，露出了底下一条软白的缝。

pairs.target: qī lán sōng xián .
pairs.english: Qi Lan released the string.
pairs.hanzi: 戚岚松弦。

pairs.target: jiàn méi jìnqù , zhī zài ké yuán shàng cā chū yídào bái hén , zhé chéng liǎngjié .
pairs.english: The arrow didn't penetrate, merely scraping a white mark along the shell's edge before breaking in two.
pairs.hanzi: 箭没进去，只在壳缘上擦出一道白痕，折成两截。

pairs.target: shěn yàn zhōu què yǐjīng gēnshàng , jiàn cóng dī chù yì tiāo , nà dōngxī fù xià biàn fān chū yípiàn hēihóng .
pairs.english: But Shen Yanzhou had already followed, flicking his sword up from below; then a dark-red gash opened beneath the creature's belly.
pairs.hanzi: 沈砚舟却已经跟上，剑从低处一挑，那东西腹下便翻出一片黑红。

pairs.target: lín zhào bùyóudé tái le tái shēnzi , yòu bèi shào píng ànzhù jiān .
pairs.english: Lin Zhao involuntarily lifted herself a little, only for Shao Ping to press her shoulder down again.
pairs.hanzi: 林照不由得抬了抬身子，又被邵平按住肩。

pairs.target: " kàn shéng . "
pairs.english: “Watch the rope.”
pairs.hanzi: “看绳。”

pairs.target: tā dītóu , cái fāxiàn shéng tóu gōuzhù le zìjǐ xié jiān .
pairs.english: She looked down and only then noticed the rope end had caught on her shoe tip.
pairs.hanzi: 她低头，才发现绳头勾住了自己鞋尖。

pairs.target: tā gǎnjǐn jiěkāi , liǎnshàng fārè , xiàmiàn què yǐ xiǎngqǐ shěn yàn zhōu de shēngyīn .
pairs.english: She hurriedly freed it, her face burning, but Shen Yanzhou's voice was already rising from below.
pairs.hanzi: 她赶紧解开，脸上发热，下面却已响起沈砚舟的声音。

pairs.target: " dùhéng , tuì bànbù .
pairs.english: “Du Heng, half a step back.
pairs.hanzi: “杜衡，退半步。

pairs.target: lán jiě kàn téng hòu . "
pairs.english: Sister Lan, watch behind the vines.”
pairs.hanzi: 岚姐看藤后。”

pairs.target: dùhéng shōujiǎo shí huàng le yíxià , chóngxīn zhànwěn , jiānbǎng yòu dī huíqù .
pairs.english: Du Heng swayed as he drew his foot back and regained his balance; his shoulder sank again.
pairs.hanzi: 杜衡收脚时晃了一下，重新站稳，肩膀又低回去。

alignment.english: as he drew his foot back

pairs.target: wēn shù shuǎi le shuǎi yòushǒu , zhǎngxīn chēng zài zìjǐ xī shàng , lián zhe chuǎn le jǐkǒu .
pairs.english: Wen Shu shook his right hand, braced his palm on his own knee and drew several breaths in succession.
pairs.hanzi: 温述甩了甩右手，掌心撑在自己膝上，连着喘了几口。

pairs.target: lín zhào wàng le tā yìyǎn .
pairs.english: Lin Zhao looked at him briefly.
pairs.hanzi: 林照望了他一眼。

pairs.target: fāngcái dùhéng nà yíxià , jìng xiàngshì cóng tā shēnshàng jièlái de .
pairs.english: Du Heng's last push had actually seemed borrowed from Wen himself.
pairs.hanzi: 方才杜衡那一下，竟像是从他身上借来的。

pairs.target: shuǐ lǐ tuō chū yìtiáo wānqū de ànsè .
pairs.english: A curved dark trail spread through the water.
pairs.hanzi: 水里拖出一条弯曲的暗色。

pairs.target: dà de méiyǒu tuìhuí duàn gǒng , fǎndǎo xié zhe shēn , cháo zuǒcè nàduàn shíbì jǐ qù .
pairs.english: The big one didn't retreat to the broken arch; instead, it edged sideways toward the left-hand stone wall.
pairs.hanzi: 大的没有退回断拱，反倒斜着身，朝左侧那段石壁挤去。

pairs.target: shòushāng de qián tuǐ tuō zài shuǐxià , měi zǒu yíxià , shēnzi biàn wāi yi wāi .
pairs.english: Its wounded foreleg dragged under the water; with every step, its body lurched.
pairs.hanzi: 受伤的前腿拖在水下，每走一下，身子便歪一歪。

pairs.target: shěn yàn zhōu méi zhuījìn tā bèi ké dǐxià , zhī ràokāi nàtiáo hái zài huīdòng de tuǐ , jiào dùhéng shǒuzhù shí biān .
pairs.english: Shen Yanzhou didn't pursue it beneath its back shell; he simply skirted the still-flailing leg and told Du Heng to hold the stone edge.
pairs.hanzi: 沈砚舟没追进它背壳底下，只绕开那条还在挥动的腿，叫杜衡守住石边。

pairs.target: téng yè hūrán yí chàn , chā jiàn de xiǎoshòu yòu cuān chūlái le .
pairs.english: The vine leaves suddenly trembled, and the arrow-pierced small beast darted out again.
pairs.hanzi: 藤叶忽然一颤，插箭的小兽又蹿出来了。

pairs.target: qī lán zhè yí jiàn méi fàng .
pairs.english: Qi Lan did not loose this arrow.
pairs.hanzi: 戚岚这一箭没放。

pairs.target: shěn yàn zhōu zhèng cóng jiàn lù lǐ jīngguò , tā shōu le gōng , cè kuà dào lìng yíkuài shítou shàng .
pairs.english: Shen Yanzhou was passing across the line of fire; she lowered her bow and sidestepped onto another stone.
pairs.hanzi: 沈砚舟正从箭路里经过，她收了弓，侧跨到另一块石头上。

pairs.target: lín zhào kànjiàn dà de zhuǎnguòshēn , yìngké cā zhe zuǒ qiáng , suìshí yán qiánggēn gǔnluò .
pairs.english: Lin Zhao saw the big one turn, its hard shell scraping the left wall as loose stones rolled down along the base.
pairs.hanzi: 林照看见大的转过身，硬壳擦着左墙，碎石沿墙根滚落。

pairs.target: nà dào gāochù de shuǐ hén xiàmiàn , yuánběn xìxì wǎng wài shènshuǐ de fèng , hūrán tǔ chū yìgǔ húnhuáng .
pairs.english: Below the high water stain, the crack that had been seeping a fine trickle suddenly spat out a rush of muddy yellow water.
pairs.hanzi: 那道高处的水痕下面，原本细细往外渗水的缝，忽然吐出一股浑黄。

pairs.target: " qiáng ——"
pairs.english: “The wall—”

pairs.target: huà méi shuōwán , qiángjiǎo biàn wǎng wài gǔ le yíkuài .
pairs.english: She hadn't finished speaking when a section bulged outward at the wall's foot.
pairs.hanzi: 话没说完，墙脚便往外鼓了一块。

pairs.target: tā xiān tīngjiàn shítou zài shuǐxià hùxiāng kēpèng , jiēzhe yìzhěngpiàn shuǐ cóng qiáng hòu pū le chūlái .
pairs.english: First she heard stones knocking together underwater; then a whole sheet of water burst from behind the wall.
pairs.hanzi: 她先听见石头在水下互相磕碰，接着一整片水从墙后扑了出来。

pairs.target: nà dōngxī bànbiān shēnzi bèi chōng dé héng guòqù , dùhéng zhuǎn dùn dǎngzhù yíkuài suìshí , yòujiǎo què cóng gāngcái zhàn de dìfāng huákāi le .
pairs.english: Half the creature's body was forced sideways; Du Heng turned his shield to block a broken stone, but his right foot slid from its position.
pairs.hanzi: 那东西半边身子被冲得横过去，杜衡转盾挡住一块碎石，右脚却从刚才站的地方滑开了。

pairs.target: dài jiàn de xiǎoshòu bèi shuǐ juàn dào duàn zhù hòu , yìshí bújiàn le .
pairs.english: The arrow-bearing small beast was swept behind the broken pillar by the water and vanished for a moment.
pairs.hanzi: 带箭的小兽被水卷到断柱后，一时不见了。

pairs.target: " huí jiē shàng ! "
pairs.english: “Back to the steps!”
pairs.hanzi: “回阶上！”

pairs.target: shěn yàn zhōu hǎn .
pairs.english: Shen Yanzhou shouted.
pairs.hanzi: 沈砚舟喊。

pairs.target: xǔ cén měngdì huítóu , wàng xiàng tā liúbái wén de dìfāng .
pairs.english: Xu Cen suddenly turned her head to look toward the place where she had left the white mark.
pairs.hanzi: 许岑猛地回头，望向她留白纹的地方。

pairs.target: " jiē kǒu zài xiǎng ! "
pairs.english: “There's noise at the foot of the steps!”
pairs.hanzi: “阶口在响！”

alignment.english: at the foot of the steps

pairs.target: lín zhào zhī kànjiàn shuǐ .
pairs.english: Lin Zhao saw only water.
pairs.hanzi: 林照只看见水。

pairs.target: xiānqián lù zhe de jǐkuài shítou quán méi le , húnshuǐ cóng zuǒbiān héngguò tíngyuàn , yìtóu zhuàng xiàng táijiē , yòu rào zhe duàn zhù xiàng yòu juàn .
pairs.english: The stones that had shown before were all gone; muddy water swept across the courtyard from the left, slammed straight into the steps, then curled around the broken pillar toward the right.
pairs.hanzi: 先前露着的几块石头全没了，浑水从左边横过庭院，一头撞向台阶，又绕着断柱向右卷。

pairs.target: zuì xiàmiàn yījí shíjiē qiàoqǐlái , hé shàngmiàn lièkāi yídào hēikǒu .
pairs.english: The lowest step tilted up, opening a black gap between it and the one above.
pairs.hanzi: 最下面一级石阶翘起来，和上面裂开一道黑口。

pairs.target: shào píng bǎ tā wǎnghòu yí zhuài , zìjǐ shēnshǒu chě guò diàosuǒ .
pairs.english: Shao Ping yanked her back and reached to grab the hauling line himself.
pairs.hanzi: 邵平把她往后一拽，自己伸手扯过吊索。

pairs.target: tā yě zhuāzhù yìtóu , yào cháo xiàmiàn pāo , shěn yàn zhōu què zài shuǐ lǐ jiào : " xiān kòuláo ! "
pairs.english: She grabbed an end too, about to throw it down, but Shen Yanzhou called from the water, “Secure it first!”
pairs.hanzi: 她也抓住一头，要朝下面抛，沈砚舟却在水里叫：“先扣牢！”

pairs.target: tā de shǒu yídùn , lìkè jiāng shéngquān ràoguò zhuàntái nèicè lián zhe qiáng de shí dūn , shào píng guìxià lái jiē zhù tiě kòu .
pairs.english: Her hands paused; she immediately looped the rope around the stone pier joined to the wall inside the landing, and Shao Ping knelt to take the iron clasp.
pairs.hanzi: 她的手一顿，立刻将绳圈绕过转台内侧连着墙的石墩，邵平跪下来接住铁扣。

pairs.target: liǎng rén lājǐn shí , shéng shàng jī zhe de shuǐ shuǎi le tā yìliǎn .
pairs.english: As they pulled it tight, water that had collected on the rope flicked into her face.
pairs.hanzi: 两人拉紧时，绳上积着的水甩了她一脸。

pairs.target: xiàmiàn de wǔgè rén hái méiyǒu shànglái .
pairs.english: The five below had not yet come up.
pairs.hanzi: 下面的五个人还没有上来。

pairs.target: dùhéng huàn dào kào hòu de shítou shàng , dùn dǎng zài xiōngqián .
pairs.english: Du Heng shifted onto a stone farther back, his shield across his chest.
pairs.hanzi: 杜衡换到靠后的石头上，盾挡在胸前。

pairs.target: wēn shù hé xǔ cén tiēzhe tā shēnhòu , qī lán réng zài yòucè , gōng tái dé hěn gāo .
pairs.english: Wen Shu and Xu Cen stayed close behind him; Qi Lan was still on the right, her bow held high.
pairs.hanzi: 温述和许岑贴着他身后，戚岚仍在右侧，弓抬得很高。

pairs.target: shěn yàn zhōu héng zài dà de yǔ táijiē zhījiān , shītòu de duǎn páo tiē zài bèishàng , jiànjiān yíxià yě méi chuí .
pairs.english: Shen Yanzhou stood across the space between the big one and the steps; his soaked short robe clung to his back, and his sword tip never dropped.
pairs.hanzi: 沈砚舟横在大的与台阶之间，湿透的短袍贴在背上，剑尖一下也没垂。

pairs.target: shuǐ yǐjīng mànguò dùhéng de xīgài .
pairs.english: The water had already risen above Du Heng's knees.
pairs.hanzi: 水已经漫过杜衡的膝盖。

pairs.target: nà zhī duàn le qián tuǐ de dōngxī hái zài wǎng tāmen zhèbiān nuó , bèi ké yì chén yì fú , jìng bǐ fāngcái zǒu dé wěn .
pairs.english: The creature with the severed foreleg was still edging toward them, its back shell rising and sinking; it actually moved more steadily than before.
pairs.hanzi: 那只断了前腿的东西还在往他们这边挪，背壳一沉一浮，竟比方才走得稳。

pairs.target: lín zhào mǒdiào yǎn shàng de shuǐ , dītóu zhǎo néng bǎ shéng pāo dào shuí de shǒulǐ .
pairs.english: Lin Zhao wiped the water from her eyes and looked down for someone whose hands she could throw the rope into.
pairs.hanzi: 林照抹掉眼上的水，低头找能把绳抛到谁的手里。

pairs.target: yòubiān nà tuán kūzhī què hūrán tíngzhù le .
pairs.english: But the clump of dead branches on the right suddenly stopped.
pairs.hanzi: 右边那团枯枝却忽然停住了。

pairs.target: zhītiáo hòumiàn , yíkuài xié zhe de shíbǎn zhī lùchū shàng yán , shuǐ jǐ zài liǎngcè , fāchū xì ér jí de sī shēng .
pairs.english: Behind the branches, only the upper edge of a tilted slab showed; water squeezed past either side with a thin and urgent hiss.
pairs.hanzi: 枝条后面，一块斜着的石板只露出上沿，水挤在两侧，发出细而急的嘶声。

pairs.target: tā shùnzhe nà diǎn báimò kàn guòqù .
pairs.english: She followed the little patch of white foam with her gaze.
pairs.hanzi: 她顺着那点白沫看过去。

pairs.target: tíngyuàn lǐ de shuǐ hái zài zhǎng , dī gǒng nà tóu , què lián yìgēn xìzhī dōu méi zài guòqù .
pairs.english: The water in the courtyard was still rising, yet not even a twig was getting through the low arch anymore.
pairs.hanzi: 庭院里的水还在涨，低拱那头，却连一根细枝都没再过去。
